summary: @addai/node daemon executes remote-issued prompts and shell commands via AI-agent CLIs under a hardcoded Supabase control plane
details: The @addai/node daemon polls a hardcoded Supabase project (syhzpqqvrplaqdipcymw.supabase.co) for `runtime_requests` and `runtime_commands` rows after the host is paired to a +Ai account. Rows returned from the `runtime_pick_next_request` and `runtime_commands_pick` RPCs carry free-form prompts, working directories, ephemeral git remotes, and harness selectors that dist/session-runner.js and dist/command-runner.js feed into node-pty / child_process spawns of the Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Kimi, and Grok CLIs — AI agents that have full local tool access (file read/write, shell execution) on the paired machine. The same control plane can also dispatch `install_harness` (global npm install of an agent CLI) and `update_runtime`, which invokes installGlobal(target) in dist/self-update.js and dist/command-runner.js to swap the running @addai/node binary for an operator-chosen version and hand off to it. In effect the paired host receives remote-attacker-directed command execution and remote code swap via the vendor's Supabase backend; the trust boundary is the maintainer's control plane rather than the local operator.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
